iti17:2.1: Sekhassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato bāhiraṃ aṅgan-ti karitvā na aññaṃ ekaṅgampi samanupassāmi evaṃ bahūpakāraṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave kalyāṇamittatā.
iti17:2.2: Kalyāṇamitto bhikkhave bhikkhu akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāvetīti.
